name: edu_same exact school degree major match
spec: Read-back (`edu_same(want, got)`): `want` is the plan's JSON list (first entry used), `got` the page's JSON object with keys `school`, and `degree` / `major` **only when the page has that box**.

name: edu_same school case-insensitive whitespace-collapsed containment
spec: The school check is unchanged: the page's school must contain the wanted school (case-insensitive, whitespace collapsed).

name: edu_same school mismatch
spec: The school check is unchanged: the page's school must contain the wanted school (case-insensitive, whitespace collapsed).

name: edu_same degree key absent is not checked
spec: A wanted part whose key is ABSENT from `got` is not checked (the page cannot show it).

name: edu_same major key absent is not checked
spec: A wanted part whose key is ABSENT from `got` is not checked (the page cannot show it).

name: edu_same degree present empty fails
spec: A key that is present but empty ("") while the wanted part is non-empty still fails.

name: edu_same major present empty fails
spec: A key that is present but empty ("") while the wanted part is non-empty still fails.

name: edu_same empty wanted parts never checked
spec: An empty wanted part is never checked.

name: edu_same unreadable want JSON false
spec: Unreadable JSON → false.

name: edu_same unreadable got JSON false
spec: Unreadable JSON → false.

name: edu_same first entry used and second ignored
spec: `want` is the plan's JSON list (first entry used).

name: edu_same first entry used so second match cannot rescue
spec: `want` is the plan's JSON list (first entry used).

name: edu_select_values four selects returns start and end
spec: 4 selects → [start_month, start_year, end_month, end_year].

name: edu_select_values two selects startDate excluded returns end pair
spec: 2 selects and "startDate" excluded → [end_month, end_year].

name: edu_select_values two selects endDate excluded returns start pair
spec: 2 selects and "endDate" excluded → [start_month, start_year].

name: edu_select_values two selects neither excluded returns empty list
spec: 2 selects and neither excluded (unknown which pair) → [] (nothing is guessed).

name: edu_select_values two selects degree excluded still neither start nor end excluded
spec: 2 selects and neither excluded (unknown which pair) → [] (nothing is guessed).

name: edu_select_values two selects startDate excluded with extra degree excluded
spec: 2 selects and "startDate" excluded → [end_month, end_year].

name: edu_select_values two selects endDate excluded with extra major excluded
spec: 2 selects and "endDate" excluded → [start_month, start_year].

name: edu_select_values four selects with degree excluded still all four
spec: 4 selects → [start_month, start_year, end_month, end_year].

name: edu_select_values zero selects returns empty list
spec: any other count (0, 1, 3 …) → [].

name: edu_select_values three selects returns empty list
spec: any other count (0, 1, 3 …) → [].

name: edu_select_values missing value becomes empty string in four-select list
spec: A value that is missing in `ent` is "" in the list.

name: edu_select_values missing value becomes empty string in two-select end pair
spec: A value that is missing in `ent` is "" in the list.
